narrative: On the part. Romeo's cue-roll lies on the trestle with the rejected hearing struck through once. Larkham's small sign is in the corner. The kept line is short. On the part. Above that line, a few words are crossed and sanded. They are still almost readable, and they are not the keeper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the kept cue and did not add to it.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Had struck the rejected hearing and signed the corner.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on part in Fire on the word
